integrity: Proof rests on determinant factorizations, an ergodic parity argument, positive Perron weights and an exact rational certificate; finite checks supplement but do not establish uniform or asymptotic claims.
scientific_limitations: Two-patch linear, no density feedback, exogenous two-state Markov environmental sequence, strictly positive initial abundances, and fixed after-reproduction migration. Results concern almost-sure logarithmic rare-population growth and not finite-population viability; the exact noisy threshold for arbitrary partial migration is not determined. Historical priority requires independent review.
title: Rare phase errors reverse complete-swap persistence in a two-patch population
